voor.The expedition wasn't only a race: You'd find microscopes and notebooks packed beside the sledges.

slot.Every inch of the deck was crammed: You'd find a dog asleep on every coil of rope.
slot.Before they reached the ice: You'd swap your thick jumper for a cotton shirt.
slot.The chief scientist was a gentle doctor: You'd trust him with anything, I think.
slot.The first iceberg they saw: You'd feel the cold coming off it from far away.
slot.The hut came from England: You'd be proud when the last board was nailed in place.
slot.Scott's little corner held a bunk: You'd see her photograph on the shelf above his bed.
slot.The warmest room in the hut: You'd be sorry when he chased you out again.
slot.The little Adélie penguins always looked: You'd never tire of watching them.
slot.On the twenty-third of April: You'd stand there in silence until the glow faded.
slot.Midwinter Day was the Antarctic Christma: You'd eat until you couldn't eat any more.
slot.When the sun came back in August: You'd feel like taking your hat off too.
slot.Inside the tent each evening: You'd fall asleep almost before your head touched the bag.
